paragraphs: EmploCore is an employee management system with role-based dashboards for admins, HR and employees. This repository is the React single-page app. It is live at
Built and maintained by Joseph Migbodzi (GitHub).
Real (non-demo) deployment: set REACTAPPDEMOMODE=false and follow the backend's docs/PRODUCTION.md.
features: Sign in with JWT authentication. Each role lands on its own dashboard (/admin, /hr, /employee).

Admin: overview (user counts, recent activity), create users, change roles, activate/deactivate users, reset passwords (temporary password or one-time link), delete users, read and filter the audit log, manage…

HR: dashboard (headcount, headcount by department, average salary, recent activity), search/filter by department, add, edit and delete employees (department chosen from a list), link employee records to user accounts,…

Departments (/hr/departments, /admin/departments): list with heads and employee counts, create/edit, activate/deactivate, delete (only when empty), view members, add or remove employees, and set the head of department.

Payroll (/hr/payroll, /admin/payroll): set each employee's pay details (basic salary, named allowances, other deductions, bank and SSNIT number) with a live net-pay calculation, run payroll for a month (all or selected…
